schema: Accenture KPI & Semantic Governance Contract Specification
organization: Accenture Decision Intelligence Platform / Signal Story

gross_sales.name: Gross Sales
gross_sales.business_definition: Total unadjusted top-line invoiced sales volume generated before returns, allowances, discounts, or post-sale cancellations.
gross_sales.grain: Monthly by Market, Customer, Product Code, Channel
gross_sales.baseline_method: 3-Month Rolling Unweighted Arithmetic Mean (T-1, T-2, T-3)
gross_sales.materiality_threshold: Absolute deviation >= 15.0% versus 3-month rolling baseline or MoM swing >= 20.0%

candidate_drivers.name: Inventory / Availability
candidate_drivers.impact_mechanism: Stockouts or low stock prevent product fulfillment and suppress top-line volume.

candidate_drivers.name: Competitive Pricing Pressure
candidate_drivers.impact_mechanism: Competitor discounts or wider positive price gap drive demand substitution.

candidate_drivers.name: Marketing Effectiveness
candidate_drivers.impact_mechanism: Campaign spend changes, conversion drops, or traffic shifts alter customer acquisition funnel.

candidate_drivers.name: Returns Spike
candidate_drivers.impact_mechanism: Surging return volumes indicate product dissatisfaction or channel distribution issues.

candidate_drivers.name: Customer Service / Support Deterioration
candidate_drivers.impact_mechanism: Customer service escalation, unresolved complaints, or negative sentiment dampens repeat purchases.

candidate_drivers.name: Customer / Segment Change
candidate_drivers.impact_mechanism: Concentration drop or purchasing reduction in specific customer tiers or channels.

candidate_drivers.name: Market / Regional Change
candidate_drivers.impact_mechanism: Macroeconomic or regional contraction localized to specific geographic jurisdictions.

candidate_drivers.name: Product / Category Mix Shift
candidate_drivers.impact_mechanism: Internal cannibalization or customer shift toward alternative category segments.

candidate_drivers.name: Unexplained / Insufficient Evidence
candidate_drivers.impact_mechanism: No single candidate driver meets evidence threshold; uncertainty preserved.

gross_sales.source_freshness: Monthly batch ETL processed at T+1 calendar day following accounting period close
gross_sales.analytical_method: Deterministic SQL/Pandas aggregation (Phase 3A) + Multi-source causal arbitration (Phase 3B)
gross_sales.lineage_reference: ERP Sales Ledger -> Data/Processed/fact_sales_monthly.csv -> AnalyticalDataModel.get_sales() -> KPIEngine.gross_sales() -> EventDetector.detect_event()

category_share.name: Category Share
category_share.business_definition: Proportion of total market sales volume accounted for by a specific category segment or product group within a target geographic market.
category_share.baseline_method: 3-Month Rolling Unweighted Arithmetic Mean (T-1, T-2, T-3)
category_share.materiality_threshold: Absolute market share swing >= 2.5 percentage points or relative change >= 10.0%

candidate_drivers.name: Product / Category Mix Shift
candidate_drivers.impact_mechanism: Cross-category portfolio substitution or shifting consumer preference toward adjacent categories.

candidate_drivers.name: Competitive Pricing Pressure
candidate_drivers.impact_mechanism: Relative category price premiums causing category-level demand migration.

candidate_drivers.name: Marketing Effectiveness
candidate_drivers.impact_mechanism: Reallocation of promotional investments across category portfolios.

category_share.source_freshness: Monthly batch ETL processed at T+1 calendar day following accounting period close
category_share.analytical_method: Comparative portfolio ratio aggregation (Phase 3A) + Category mix diagnostic (Phase 3B)
category_share.lineage_reference: ERP Sales Ledger -> Data/Processed/fact_sales_monthly.csv -> AnalyticalDataModel.get_joined_sales() -> KPIEngine.share_percentage() -> EventDetector.detect_event()

signed_net_revenue.name: Signed Net Revenue
signed_net_revenue.business_definition: True net revenue recognized after subtracting validated return amounts from gross sales revenue.
signed_net_revenue.grain: Monthly by Market, Customer, Product Code, Channel
signed_net_revenue.baseline_method: 3-Month Rolling Unweighted Arithmetic Mean (T-1, T-2, T-3)

candidate_drivers.name: Returns Spike
candidate_drivers.impact_mechanism: Direct reduction in net recognized revenue from product return claims.

candidate_drivers.name: Inventory / Availability
candidate_drivers.impact_mechanism: Gross volume restriction reducing revenue base.

signed_net_revenue.source_freshness: Monthly batch ETL processed at T+1 calendar day following accounting period close

return_rate.name: Return Rate
return_rate.business_definition: Ratio of returned merchandise quantity or monetary value relative to gross volume shipped.
return_rate.calculation: SUM(return_qty) / SUM(gross_qty) [Unit Rate] or SUM(return_sales_amount) / SUM(gross_sales_amount) [Value Rate]
return_rate.materiality_threshold: Return rate elevation >= 5.0 percentage points above baseline

candidate_drivers.name: Returns Spike
candidate_drivers.impact_mechanism: Defect clusters, shipment damage, or customer mismatch.

candidate_drivers.name: Customer Service / Support Deterioration
candidate_drivers.impact_mechanism: Support escalations resulting in return authorizations.

return_rate.source_freshness: Monthly batch ETL processed at T+1 calendar day

marketing_spend.name: Marketing Investment (Ad Spend)
marketing_spend.business_definition: Total direct marketing capital allocated across digital advertising channels, paid search, and promotional campaigns.
marketing_spend.grain: Monthly by Market, Product Category, Channel
marketing_spend.materiality_threshold: Spend variance >= 20.0% versus planned allocation or prior rolling average

candidate_drivers.name: Marketing Effectiveness
candidate_drivers.impact_mechanism: Investment scale changes altering acquisition efficiency.

conversion_rate.name: Marketing Conversion Rate
conversion_rate.business_definition: Percentage of marketing ad click interactions that result in completed commercial conversions or purchase transactions.
conversion_rate.grain: Monthly by Market, Product Category, Campaign Channel
conversion_rate.materiality_threshold: Conversion rate decline >= 20.0% relative to rolling baseline

candidate_drivers.name: Marketing Effectiveness
candidate_drivers.impact_mechanism: Landing page funnel friction, audience targeting mismatch, or creative fatigue.

conversion_rate.lineage_reference: Web Analytics / Ad Platforms -> fact_marketing_monthly.csv -> KPIEngine.conversion_rate()

price_gap.name: Competitive Price Gap
price_gap.business_definition: Average percentage premium or discount of our product pricing relative to benchmarked competitor market pricing.
price_gap.materiality_threshold: Price gap expansion >= 5.0 percentage points premium relative to baseline

candidate_drivers.name: Competitive Pricing Pressure
candidate_drivers.impact_mechanism: Competitor promotional discounting creating unfavorable price differential.

price_gap.source_freshness: Monthly competitor web scraping and syndicate pricing feed
price_gap.analytical_method: Mean price differential computation via KPIEngine.price_gap()
